newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sierra estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sierra estimates cut.

text.p: - Robertson Stephens & Co cut its 1996 earnings estimate for Sierra Semiconductor Corp to $0.80 a share from $1.00 after the company said it planned to exit the modem-chip business, analyst Elias Moosa said.
- The brokerage cut its 1997 estimate to $0.65 a share from $1.22, he said.
- Still, the brokerage retained its buy recommendation on the expectation the company will emerge smaller but more profitable.
- Moosa sees revenues of $190 million this year and $110 million next year, compared with $189 million in 1995.
